theorems.name: Submission.ts_first_variation_of_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : RectifiablePair n ℓ) (N₀ : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (C : ℕ → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (ε : ℝ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → MeasurableSet N₀ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) N₀ = 0 → a.M ⊆ N₀ ∪ ⋃ i, F i '' C i → (∀ i, IsCompact (C i) ∧ (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F i)) ∧ (∀ w ∈ C i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) w ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (F i) w)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (F i)) (C i) ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ v ∈ C i, ∀ w ∈ C i, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F i v - F i w‖) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M, ∀ i, ∀ w ∈ C i, F i w = x → (mk a).tangentSpace x = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (F i) w).toLinearMap) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ ((mk a).tangentSpace x).starProjection) ((μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)).restrict a.M) → IsCompactVariation φ ε K → HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ (imageMass a (φ t) K).toReal) (∫ x, (mk a).tangentialDiv (fun y ↦ deriv (fun t ↦ φ t y) 0) x ∂(mk a).weight) 0
